item.title: Version 0.5.11
item.description:
• Nodes on a VPN now get work — a node that reaches the share over WireGuard or Tailscale advertised its tunnel address, so the office nodes could not reach it. minRender now advertises the address it actually uses to reach the share.
  • Peer addresses no longer go stale — Windows kept serving other nodes the first version of a peer's address file it had opened, for an hour or more, after the file changed on the share. Nodes now write that file once per farm start, and only re-read a peer's file when the share listing shows it changed, so the cached copy cannot mask a change.
  • IP override applies on Save — changing the advertised IP in Settings now restarts the farm services like the other network settings do, instead of waiting for a relaunch.
  • Dead peers are dropped — a node whose address file has gone from the share is removed from the peer list instead of being polled forever.

Action needed — every node should move to 0.5.11; nodes still on 0.5.10 keep rewriting their address file every 3 seconds, which is what trips the caching on the other Windows nodes. Windows nodes restart on their own after the Store update.

item.title: Version 0.5.10
item.description:
• Windows nodes come back after Store updates — a Microsoft Store update closes minRender to install the new version. From 0.5.10 on, Windows starts it again straight after the update, minimized to the tray, so the node rejoins the farm by itself. It also restarts minRender if it crashes.
  • Safer Store packaging — the Windows package build now refuses to produce a package with capabilities the Store has rejected before.
  • macOS — no changes beyond the version number. The plug-ins are now 0.5.10; they only differ from 0.5.9 in their version.

Action needed — Windows nodes: the update to 0.5.10 still closes minRender without restarting it, because 0.5.9 could not ask for a restart. Start minRender once on each node after it updates. Later updates restart it on their own.

item.title: Version 0.5.9
item.description:
• Plug-ins on the farm share stay current — only a node running a newer minRender refreshes the farm's templates and plug-ins, so an older node can no longer copy its older files back over them. A copy that fails is retried on the next start instead of being skipped until the next version, and every copy is now recorded in the node's log on the farm.
  • Correct plug-ins in the macOS app — 0.5.8 for macOS shipped with an earlier build of the Blender, After Effects and Cinema 4D plug-ins. They worked, but showed the wrong version. The plug-ins are now 0.5.9 everywhere.
  • Windows title bar — Windows uses the standard Windows title bar and frame again, always dark. This fixes white borders and wrong or invisible minimize, maximize and close buttons on Windows 10 and on PCs set to light mode.

Action needed — reinstall the plug-ins from the farm share's plugins folder (version 0.5.9) on workstations that submit jobs. Nodes still on 0.5.5 can overwrite that folder with older plug-ins when they restart, until they are updated.

item.title: Version 0.5.8
item.description:
minRender 0.5.8

Includes everything from 0.5.6 and 0.5.7, which were never published to this update channel.

  • Refreshed interface — Geist type, softly rounded controls, smooth hover feedback and menus and dialogs that fade in.
  • New title bar — the window's title row now shows this node's name, its leader badge and its status, with New Job always one click away.
  • Multi-select and keyboard — the job, chunk and node lists support Cmd-click, Shift-click, arrow keys, Cmd-A and Escape. Chunk and node menus act on the whole selection. Return or double-click opens Edit Job, and Cmd-Backspace deletes.
  • Security hardening — job and node ids are validated before they touch the farm share, farm cleanup can only delete inside the farm's own folders, oversized API requests are rejected, and the agent socket now lives in the per-user temp directory.
  • Job list fix — the State column and per-chunk states show again.
  • Windows nodes — Windows now installs and updates through the Microsoft Store, runs on Windows 10 and 11, and keeps its data in %USERPROFILE%\minRender. Action needed on mixed farms: reinstall the Blender, After Effects and Cinema 4D plug-ins from the farm share's plugins folder (version 0.5.8). On Windows nodes that used RNDR dual mode, install the companion from tools/rndr-companion.

item.title: Version 0.5.5
item.description:
minRender 0.5.5

Includes everything from 0.5.4, which was never published as a release.

  • Node suspension is now visible — a node benched by the leader after repeated chunk failures used to keep reporting "ok" and looked like a healthy idle peer that silently never received work. Peer rows now show a red dot, a warning glyph and the failure count instead of "idle", and This Node grows a banner with an Unsuspend button. Workers mirror the leader's verdict by polling it every few seconds; a failed poll keeps the last known state rather than blanking it.
  • Unsuspend from any machine — the peer menu's Unsuspend is enabled only for nodes that are actually suspended, so clearing a bench no longer means walking to another workstation.
  • Packaging — 0.5.4's installer was packaged from a tree that didn't match any commit on main; 0.5.5 is rebuilt clean so the shipped artifact corresponds to a real commit.

item.title: Version 0.5.3
item.description:
minRender 0.5.3

  • API hardening — the /api/config endpoints now require the farm token (the old exemption let any LAN host read and rewrite farm settings), auth fails closed when the farm secret can't be read, token comparison is constant-time, and log/output routes reject path-traversal segments.
  • Peer endpoint hardening — UDP heartbeats can no longer create peers or change a peer's address; endpoint.json on the farm share is the sole authority, so a spoofed packet can't redirect leader traffic (and the farm secret) to an attacker-chosen host.
  • Secret fingerprint — Settings and /api/status now show a short fingerprint of the farm secret, so nodes that disagree about the secret are easy to spot instead of producing a wall of 401s.
  • Windows binaries — every shipped executable now embeds full version metadata, reducing Windows Defender false positives on unsigned builds.
  • Launch fixes — the launch-at-login shortcut's --minimized flag is honored (the window no longer opens on every login; use the tray icon to open it), and "Check for Updates…" is greyed out in builds without an updater.
  • Action needed — update all farm nodes: the auth and peer-endpoint fixes only protect nodes running 0.5.3.

item.title: Version 0.5.2
item.description:
minRender 0.5.2

  • Blender 5.2 — the bundled Blender templates and submission addon now target Blender 5.2 (Windows executable path: C:/Program Files/Blender Foundation/Blender 5.2). The old 5.1 templates are replaced on the farm share on first launch.
  • Action needed — reinstall the Blender addon (Install from Disk, from the farm share's plugins/blender/MinRender.py) so submissions use the new template. Keep Blender 5.1 installed on render nodes until jobs submitted before this update have finished.

item.title: Version 0.5.1
item.description:
minRender 0.5.1

  • Priority & drag-to-reorder fixes — dragging jobs in the queue works again, can cross priority groups (the job adopts the target's priority), and the selection highlight follows the dragged job.
  • Edit Job fix — corrected a flag misalignment when seeding the job editor that could corrupt chunk resubmits.
  • Staging copy-back hardening — workers now own output-directory creation, retry delivery, and no longer complete silently on copy failures.

item.title: Version 0.5.0
item.description:
minRender 0.5.0

  • Frame preview — click frames or chunks in the grid to preview rendered EXR/PNG/TIFF output right in the monitor, with an EXR layer picker. Works from any node.
  • Edit Job — change a submitted job's parameters and apply to the next chunks, restart in-flight work, or start over. Edits are acknowledged by the leader and queue to the farm share if it's unreachable.
  • Stop chunk & resubmit — stop a chunk (its frames leave the progress accounting; the job finishes "partial") and resubmit it as a new job with different parameters, e.g. one frame per node.
  • UI overhaul — tabbed detail pane, modal submission, resizable columns, durations, selectable node rows, async farm cleanup with per-section select-all, and a Show in Finder button for logs.
  • Farm reliability — nodes advertise capabilities across versions; a render fence prevents double-rendered frames after edits or connection flaps; VPN-friendly timeouts stop remote nodes from being flagged dead.

Rolling upgrade safe: older nodes keep working unchanged; version-dependent features stay disabled until the leader updates.
